prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new original One Ring elven culture illustration: elves in a magnificent ancient refuge city among waterfalls, evoking Rivendell. Wide 16:9 landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. A sweeping hidden wooded mountain valley filled with gracefully terraced elven halls, slender stone arches and airy bridges spanning immense cascades. Multiple waterfalls tumble from high cliff ledges past the city into luminous mist, a river threads the ravine below. Timeless elegant curved roofs and architecture integrated with rock, trees and terraces, grounded understated beauty, not a sprawling extravagant fantasy metropolis. In the foreground on the lower-left third, three slender cloaked elves stand on a stone terrace or bridge looking across their city, one carrying a simple elegant bow. Pointed ears can be suggested in profile but no close-up portraits. Figures are small enough to give the architecture and waterfalls grandeur, together less than a quarter of the frame. Follow the user's required style: VERY BROAD, THICK expressive gouache and oil-like brush strokes, rough palette-knife blocks, dragged broken paint edges, coarse scumbled pigment texture, large simplified painterly shapes and lost edges. No intricate fine detail, photorealism, engraved ornament, tiny masonry marks, individual hair strands, crisp eyes, chain links or glossy 3D concept rendering. Crucial lighting: the elves are shrouded in deep charcoal, forest-green and blue-black shadow, nearly silhouettes with faint edge-light. The environment behind them is clearly brighter: pale waterfall foam, luminous cool mist, soft cloud-filtered light on distant stone terraces and muted mossy forest, restrained warm ivory highlights in the distant sky. Foreground shadow and dark tree framing contrast with the radiant valley depth. Palette: desaturated deep greens, slate-blue, cool gray stone and pale silver water, tiny muted warm gold accents. Mood: ancient, secluded, quietly majestic and hopeful, mysterious rather than cheerful postcard. Broad shapes and expressive thick paint must carry the image; the detail level should resemble a bold traditional fantasy book painting, not a detailed realistic illustration. Full coherent rectangular artwork to every edge. No labels, writing, title, heraldic text, borders, white strips, black bars, watermark or UI.
